stages.headline: For the point M of the unit semicircle whose radius makes angle α with Ox (0° ≤ α ≤ 180°): sin α = y, cos α = x, tg α = y/x.
stages.headlineEnglish: For the point M of the unit semicircle whose radius makes angle α with Ox (0° ≤ α ≤ 180°): sin α = y, cos α = x, tg α = y/x.

stages.headline: For an acute angle this matches the right-triangle definitions: sin = opposite/hypotenuse, cos = adjacent/hypotenuse, tg = opposite/adjacent.
stages.headlineEnglish: For an acute angle this matches the right-triangle definitions: sin = opposite/hypotenuse, cos = adjacent/hypotenuse, tg = opposite/adjacent.
